# Command line

The `quantum` command. Every command takes `-h` / `--help`. The Guide explains the everyday ones: [CLI commands](../tools/cli).

::: v-pre

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--version` | The installed version. |
| `-h, --help` | The commands and their options. |

<a id="cli-run"></a>

## `quantum run`

Execute a .q file.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | .q file to execute |  |  |
| `--debug` | Debug mode |  |  |
| `--config` | Config file | `quantum.config.yaml` |  |
| `--target` | UI target (for type="ui" apps): html, textual, or mobile | `html` | `html`, `textual`, `mobile` |
| `--engine` | Game engine backend: pixi (default, HTML5) or godot (Godot 4 project) | `pixi` | `pixi`, `godot` |

Specified by: [IA-7](./spec#IA-7) · [CFG-1](./spec#CFG-1) · [UI-0](./spec#UI-0) · [UI-2](./spec#UI-2) · [UI-8](./spec#UI-8)

### `quantum pkg init`

|---|---|---|---|
| `[path]` | Directory to initialize (default: current directory) | `.` |  |
| `-n, --name` | Package name (default: directory name) |  |  |
| `-d, --description` | Package description |  |  |
| `-a, --author` | Package author |  |  |

<a id="cli-pkg-publish"></a>

### `quantum pkg publish`

Create publishable package archive.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[path]` | Package directory (default: current directory) | `.` |  |

<a id="cli-pkg-install"></a>

### `quantum pkg install`

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | Package source (local path or git URL) |  |  |
| `-v, --version` | Specific version to install |  |  |
| `--no-deps` | Skip dependency resolution |  |  |

<a id="cli-jobs"></a>

## `quantum jobs`

Manage scheduled jobs and job queues.

<a id="cli-jobs-list"></a>

### `quantum jobs list`

List all scheduled jobs.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | Filter by status | `all` | `all`, `active`, `paused`, `pending`, `running`, `failed` |
| `--queue` | Filter by queue name |  |  |
| `--format` | Output format | `table` | `table`, `json` |

<a id="cli-jobs-status"></a>

### `quantum jobs status`

Get detailed job status.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Job name |  |  |
| `--format` | Output format | `table` | `table`, `json` |

<a id="cli-jobs-run"></a>

### `quantum jobs run`

Run a job manually.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Job name |  |  |
| `--sync` | Wait for job to complete |  |  |
| `--params` | JSON parameters for the job |  |  |

<a id="cli-jobs-pause"></a>

### `quantum jobs pause`

Pause a scheduled job.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Job name |  |  |

<a id="cli-jobs-resume"></a>

### `quantum jobs resume`

Resume a paused job.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Job name |  |  |

<a id="cli-jobs-cancel"></a>

### `quantum jobs cancel`

Cancel a running or pending job.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Job name or job ID |  |  |

<a id="cli-jobs-history"></a>

### `quantum jobs history`

View job execution history.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[name]` | Job name (optional, shows all if not specified) |  |  |
| `--limit` | Number of entries to show | `10` |  |
| `--status` |  | `all` | `all`, `success`, `failed` |
| `--format` | Output format | `table` | `table`, `json` |

<a id="cli-jobs-worker"></a>

### `quantum jobs worker`

Start a job worker process.

<a id="cli-jobs-worker-start"></a>

#### `quantum jobs worker start`

Start worker.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--queue` | Queue(s) to process (comma-separated) | `default` |  |
| `--concurrency` | Number of concurrent workers | `4` |  |
| `--poll-interval` | Poll interval in seconds | `1.0` |  |

<a id="cli-jobs-worker-stop"></a>

#### `quantum jobs worker stop`

Stop worker.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--graceful` | Wait for running jobs to complete |  |  |
